description: Work out budget vs actual variances for a period. Send each line's account name, type (revenue or expense), budget and actual. Get back, per line, the variance in money (actual minus budget) and in percent of budget, whether it is favorable or unfavorable for that type of account, totals for revenue, expense and net (revenue minus expense), the largest movers, and, if you send a money and/or percent threshold, the lines that need an explanation. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/budget-variance). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

label.description: Optional label for the report, e.g. 'March 2026' (your own text, echoed).

lines.description: Budget lines (up to 200), each with account, type, budget and actual.

account.description: Account or line name, e.g. '6100 Rent' or '01-4000-100 Sales East' (your own text, echoed back). Segmented codes are fine; refused: more than 6 digits with no separator, more than 12 in all, or the shape of an SSN (3-2-4 digits), a phone number (3-3-4 digits or + and 7 or more) or a date with a 19xx or 20xx year.

actual.description: Actual amount for the same period.

type.description: revenue (income lines: more is better) or expense (cost lines: less is better).

threshold_amount.description: Optional: a line needs an explanation when its variance is at least this much money (either direction).

threshold_percent.description: Optional: a line needs an explanation when its variance is at least this percent of budget (either direction).

top_n.description: How many largest movers to list (default 5).

name: budget_variance
title: Budget vs Actual Variance
